data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Phanice, meaning 'man of Phanus', or 'graceful, free, fair'. In Greek mythology, Phanus was the god of light, knowledge, and prophecy. The name Fanchie carries the meaning “Graceful, Free, Fair” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fanchie usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, free, fair and live with faith, good character and purpose.
